candidates.name: Zhangshu

source_notes.title: Scramble: China Air Force ORBAT, Zhangshu
source_notes.note: Scramble lists Zhangshu at 28 deg 01 min 25 sec N, 115 deg 33 min 00 sec E with the 14th Fighter Division / 42nd Air Regiment and says the 42nd Air Brigade operated J-7L fighters from this base until 2017, after which the J-7L went to the 21st Brigade and the airbase was rebuilt for H-6-like bombers.

source_notes.title: Mindat/GeoNames feature 11493661: Zhangshu
source_notes.note: Mindat mirrors the GeoNames feature ID, Zhangshu name, airbase class, and queue coordinates.

candidates.rationale: Use 2017 as a conservative terminal marker for the documented Zhangshu fighter-airbase configuration. The source supports a change in operational use, not the original base opening.

source_notes.note: Scramble lists Yingshan/North at 31 deg 39 min 45 sec N, 113 deg 49 min 04 sec E with the Corps of PLA airborne troops fixed-wing transport Dadui and says 6x8x serials were replaced by 6x5x serials in 2012, with later 2014 and 2017 changes.

source_notes.title: Mindat/GeoNames feature 11493674: Yingshan North
source_notes.note: Mindat mirrors the GeoNames feature ID, Yingshan North name, airbase class, and coordinates matching the Yingshan/North listing.

candidates.rationale: Use 2012 as a conservative documented operational marker for the Yingshan/North airborne transport unit. This does not assert the airfield was established in 2012.

candidates.name: Yangcun

source_notes.note: Scramble lists Yangcun at 39 deg 22 min 25 sec N, 117 deg 05 min 36 sec E with the 72nd Air Brigade and 1st August Aerial Demo Team, and says the 72nd Regiment started receiving J-10A aircraft in 2009; it also says 1st August started receiving J-10AY/J-10SY aircraft in 2009.

source_notes.title: Mindat/GeoNames feature 11493685: Yangcun
source_notes.note: Mindat mirrors the GeoNames feature ID, Yangcun name, airbase class, and queue coordinates.

candidates.name: Xingcheng

source_notes.title: Scramble: China Naval Aviation ORBAT, Huangdicun/Xingcheng
source_notes.note: Scramble lists the Xingcheng-area Huangdicun base and says that up to 2013 the 3rd Regiment operated HJ-5/H-5 aircraft from Xingcheng in the bomber/navigation trainer role.

source_notes.title: Mindat/GeoNames feature 11493697: Xingcheng
source_notes.note: Mindat mirrors the GeoNames feature ID, Xingcheng name, airbase class, and queue coordinates near the Huangdicun/Xingcheng naval aviation area.

candidates.rationale: Use 2013 as a conservative end marker for the documented HJ-5/H-5 training role at Xingcheng. The source supports a role ending by 2013, not closure of all airbase activity.

source_notes.note: Scramble lists Wugong at 34 deg 16 min 33 sec N, 108 deg 15 min 57 sec E with the 36th Bomber Division / 108th Air Regiment and Factory 5702, and says January 2017 saw the arrival of the first H-6K aircraft, with H-6M aircraft going to the new 30th Regiment.

source_notes.title: Mindat/GeoNames feature 11493720: Wugong
source_notes.note: Mindat mirrors the GeoNames feature ID, Wugong name, airbase class, and queue coordinates.
